data.display_address: Vida Dubai Mall Tower 1, Vida Residences Dubai Mall, Downtown Dubai, Dubai
data.long_description:
Live above the city in this brand new, fully furnished 1 bedroom apartment in Vida Dubai Mall Tower 1, perfectly positioned in the heart of Downtown Dubai.

This newly handed over residence offers 759.72 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, complemented by two modern bathrooms and refined, contemporary finishes. The apartment is vacant and ready to move in.

Designed to deliver the experience of four-star hotel living with the comfort of home, residents enjoy an added privilege:
a 20% exclusive discount on selected hotel services, including:

- Poolside services
- In-room dining
- Hotel restaurants

This rare benefit enhances everyday living, allowing residents to enjoy premium hospitality at preferred resident rates.

Amenities & Lifestyle:

Residents enjoy access to world-class, hotel-style amenities, including:

- Infinity swimming pool with Downtown & Burj Khalifa views
- Fully equipped fitness centre & yoga deck
- Children’s play area (Qix Club)
- Co-working spaces and stylish resident lounges
- 24/7 concierge, housekeeping & security services

Building Overview:

Vida Dubai Mall Residences is a prestigious, fully serviced development directly connected to The Dubai Mall via an air-conditioned bridge. The building reflects Vida’s signature style modern, warm, and effortlessly elegant offering a refined lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most iconic addresses.
